inputModalities.ref: opencode Console Go grok-4.5 /responses image input
evidence: models.dev publishes grok-4.5 with input modalities text and image, and the opencode-go roster lists the model, so the catalog planned a vision evaluation for it.

Measured against the live gateway on 2026-08-23: a text-only /responses request returns 200, while every request carrying an image returns 400 'Error from provider (Console Go): Upstream request failed: [400] invalid request'.

The refusal is not a payload shape or an encoding. input_image with a string image_url is the shape the API validates (the nested {url} and chat-style image_url forms are rejected earlier with 'validation failed'), and both a PNG data URL and a public https JPEG URL are refused identically.

It is not the gateway or the protocol either: opencode-go/gpt-5.6-luna is served over the same /responses endpoint and answers image requests 200, grading 5/5 on the vision fixture. The refusal is specific to this offering.
Recorded as an offer-level fact. It says this provider's grok-4.5 offering serves no images; it makes no claim about the upstream x-ai/grok-4.5 model.
